baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two focus words realize F-R-Q as an active feminine plural followed by its cognate accusative, foregrounding the operation rather than naming its object.
baseline_models.mechanism: A plurality of agents establishes a perceptible boundary between two items or states, while the cognate accusative intensifies the completion of that discrimination.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies discrimination and setting-apart between two things, making boundary production the focus operation.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified group performs an unspecified separation.
changed_reading.after: Plural agents make a decisive boundary perceptible, whether the separated terms are physical, conceptual, verbal, or social.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active plural and repeated F-R-Q root can denote repeated action upon a collective rather than one abstract distinction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The operation takes a previously coherent whole and distributes its members into separated parts; plurality permits coordinated or repeated partition.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies dispersal of a gathered whole into parts, turning the focus into active decomposition and distribution.

changed_reading.before: The focus only distinguishes one thing from another.
changed_reading.after: The focus breaks a gathered field into distributed fractions, with separation measured by the loss of prior cohesion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled F-R-Q construction can intensify a concrete splitting event and its material result.
baseline_models.mechanism: Force opens a continuous medium and leaves distinct masses on either side; separation is a change in topology, not merely a classification.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies cleaving and the production of separated masses, giving the focus a concrete rupture mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Separation is an intellectual act of telling categories apart.
changed_reading.after: Separation physically cleaves a medium so that formerly continuous matter stands in distinct masses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: F-R-Q in the active plural can be read through the branch-point image, with the cognate accusative stressing the fork itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents create or operate junctions at which one course becomes multiple trajectories; the decisive result is divergent routing.

activation_trace.role: This branch supplies a road fork or parting point, recasting separation as the production of divergent routes.

changed_reading.before: The agents divide objects already present before them.
changed_reading.after: The agents establish forks that send participants along different courses.

context_deltas.mechanism: Force first loosens and drives material, spreading exposes its components, and F-R-Q then sorts the field into distinct fractions. Dispersal and discrimination become serial stages rather than rival senses.

activation_trace.role: Partitive dispersal supplies the focus operation that resolves an exposed field into separated fractions.
Violent wind that carries and scatters things supplies the force that loosens the field before sorting.
Opening and spreading with branching supplies the exposure of components upon which focused separation can operate.

structural_cues: 77:2-4 are adjacent feminine-plural active participles, each followed by a cognate accusative, and the focus follows spreading with an immediate fa-link.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent scattering followed by spreading before F-R-Q; I infer an operational order in which dispersal exposes components for sorting. A live alternative is that the three oath images are parallel rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: F-R-Q either distinguishes or scatters, with no reason to relate the senses.
changed_reading.after: F-R-Q is the sorting phase of a winnowing-like sequence: force disperses, spreading exposes, and separation resolves the exposed mixture.

context_deltas.mechanism: F-R-Q articulates differences that can be cast as a reminder, and that reminder is then functionally divided into exculpation or warning. The focus becomes a semantic and forensic separator within communication.

activation_trace.role: Discrimination between two terms supplies the semantic boundary that makes the following message bifurcate in function.
Casting something until it is delivered supplies the transmission step after distinctions have been formed.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the content whose consequences are divided by the focus operation.
Excuse or exculpation supplies one explicit functional output of the delivered reminder.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the contrasting functional output of the delivered reminder.

structural_cues: 77:4-6 continue a fa-linked sequence, and 77:6 explicitly coordinates two contrasting outputs with 'or'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, casting, reminder, and an explicit excuse-or-warning pair; I infer that separation makes the message's two legal-rhetorical functions legible. Alternatively, excuse and warning may qualify the reminder without causally depending on the focus action.

changed_reading.before: The separators perform a physical or abstract division with no communicative product.
changed_reading.after: They articulate distinctions into a delivered reminder whose reception can establish excuse or activate warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The separation is assigned a fixed terminus and becomes adjudicative: at the appointed limit, a judgment exposes the boundary between true and false claims and their bearers.

activation_trace.role: Boundary-making supplies the operation later specified as a decisive judgment rather than indefinite natural separation.
Fixing something to a time or terminal limit makes the focus operation scheduled rather than continuous.
A prescribed temporal endpoint supplies the deadline at which latent distinctions become final.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood specifies the juridical function of focused F-R-Q.

structural_cues: The named day of decision appears at 77:13, is expanded by a question at 77:14, and is declared again at 77:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed timing, a prescribed endpoint, and judicial separation; I infer that the focus action anticipates the scheduled adjudication. A live alternative is that the opening agents only precede or announce that event without performing its judgment.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an atemporal separating activity.
changed_reading.after: The focus anticipates a fixed terminal adjudication in which previously contestable distinctions become enforceable outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separation becomes a layered dismantling of the visible order: marks and light are erased, a continuous overhead is opened, and fixed masses are uprooted from place.

activation_trace.role: Cleaving a medium into separated masses anchors the later cosmic changes in the focus root.
Erasing a visible trace supplies the first mode of cosmic boundary loss.
Opening a fissure between two sides supplies the direct cleaving analogue for the focus.
Uprooting and removing a mass from its place supplies separation by loss of anchorage.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 form three successive conditional clauses that move from stars to sky to mountains immediately after the promised occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erasure, fissuring, and uprooting across cosmic layers; I infer that the focus cleaving is a compact preview of their shared dismantling logic. Alternatively, those later changes may be independent signs rather than effects of the focus agents.

changed_reading.before: Material cleaving is one isolated lexical possibility in the focus.
changed_reading.after: The focus can prefigure systematic cosmic disassembly by erasure, opening, and removal from fixed place.

context_deltas.mechanism: F-R-Q can operate constructively inside creation: estimation supplies a specification, state-change realizes it, and bounded measure turns undifferentiated fluid into distinct embodied kinds.

activation_trace.role: Distinct kinds and aspects anchor a reading of separation as individuation rather than destruction.
Estimating and proportioning a thing supplies the specification from which distinct form can emerge.
Causing a thing to become a state supplies the realization step in generative differentiation.
A measure that brings something to its limit supplies boundedness and individuation.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from lowly fluid through placement to a known measure and culminates in repeated Q-D-R forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, state-change, and a bounded developmental limit; I infer that differentiation occurs within making, producing distinct forms from common material. Alternatively, the creation section may only demonstrate power for the later judgment.

changed_reading.before: Separation only destroys cohesion or sorts completed entities.
changed_reading.after: Separation can be generative individuation, drawing bounded kinds and persons out of initially common material.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single containing earth holds opposed populations while preserving the categorical line between them. Separation therefore need not mean spatial distance; it can maintain difference inside one receptacle.

activation_trace.role: Discrimination between two states supplies the categorical boundary maintained within one container.
Gathering and enclosing within a receptacle supplies the shared spatial field that does not erase difference.
Animate life supplies one member of the explicit binary held by the earth.
Departure of life supplies the opposed state whose difference persists within the same earth.

structural_cues: 77:25 asks about the earth as a container, and 77:26 answers with a compact coordinated life-death pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one enclosing earth and two opposed states; I infer that F-R-Q preserves a categorical boundary inside shared containment. A live alternative is that the pair merely inventories what the earth holds without activating the focus.

changed_reading.before: To separate is to move entities away from one another.
changed_reading.after: To separate can be to keep life and death categorically distinct even while one earth gathers both.

context_deltas.mechanism: The terminal separation operates on a deliberately assembled totality: dispersed generations are first brought into one field, judgment establishes the decisive boundary, and the whole becomes distinct parties.

activation_trace.role: The separate-party branch anchors the outcome of partitioning the assembled population into distinct groups.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the criterion by which the gathered whole is partitioned.
Bringing dispersed members together into a whole supplies the necessary input to terminal separation.

structural_cues: 77:38 places the declared day of decision and the gathering of present and former peoples in the same ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment and gathering side by side; I infer a gather-then-separate procedure in which assembly makes comparison and partition possible. Alternatively, gathering may be only a prerequisite for witnessing judgment, not the mechanism of the focus action.

changed_reading.before: The focus scatters an already gathered whole outward.
changed_reading.after: The focus is terminal partition after universal assembly: gathering intensifies rather than negates the eventual separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: F-R-Q distinguishes two scenes that share the surface category of shade by testing function: one covering cannot shelter or suffice against flame, while the other is paired with protected persons and springs.

activation_trace.role: Discrimination between superficially similar things anchors a functional rather than merely nominal distinction.
A covering shadow supplies the nominally sheltering surface of the condemned scene.
Shelter and protection supply the effective counterpart in the scene of the protected.
Sufficiency supplies the functional test that the first shade explicitly fails.
Deflecting harm by protection supplies the criterion embodied by the occupants of the second shade.

structural_cues: The same Z-L-L root frames 77:30-31 and 77:41; the first scene denies shade and efficacy, while the later scene pairs shade with springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same shade label with opposite protective efficacy; I infer that focus separation is a diagnostic test that distinguishes reality from resemblance. Alternatively, the two shade scenes may simply contrast outcomes without retroactively specifying F-R-Q.

changed_reading.before: Separation distinguishes entities by visible category or label.
changed_reading.after: Separation tests function beneath a shared label, exposing the difference between apparent shelter and protection that actually deflects harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fork becomes spatially executable: unimpeded departure sends a population toward a structure divided into three branches, so separation is realized as directed divergence along routes.

activation_trace.role: A fork in a road supplies the focus anchor for separation as divergent routing.
Unimpeded departure supplies movement away from the prior field and into a routed destination.
Branching and divergence supply the explicit spatial multiplication of the route's endpoint.

structural_cues: The departure imperative is repeated at 77:29-30 and terminates in an explicitly three-branched destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded departure and a branched destination; I infer that the focus separator functions like a routing junction. A live alternative is that branching describes only the destination's shape and has no relation to the opening F-R-Q.

changed_reading.before: The focus divides a stationary object or population.
changed_reading.after: The focus creates divergent trajectories, with separation becoming visible in where participants are sent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nearly identical consumption commands are separated by cause, duration, and outcome: one is untroubled recompense for prior work, while the other is enjoyment explicitly bounded as little. F-R-Q becomes a discriminator of horizons beneath similar acts.

activation_trace.role: Discriminating superficially similar acts anchors the distinction between two consumption scenes.
Eating supplies the repeated surface action in the first scene.
The same eating action supplies the parallel surface whose horizon differs in the second scene.
Intentional work supplies the antecedent cause attached to the first consumption scene.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the durable logic of the first scene's outcome.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the second scene's superficially attractive but qualified experience.
Smallness and paucity supply the limiting horizon that differentiates the second enjoyment.

structural_cues: 77:43 and 77:46 begin with the same eating imperative, but only the first joins drinking, ease, prior work, and recompense; the second limits enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel commands with different causal and temporal qualifiers; I infer that F-R-Q trains attention on consequential differences beneath verbal similarity. Alternatively, the parallel may be local irony without activating the opening separator.

changed_reading.before: The focus separates different objects or populations by obvious features.
changed_reading.after: The focus also separates look-alike acts by provenance and horizon: recompensed enjoyment and briefly tolerated enjoyment are not the same event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the J-R-M surface identifies wrongdoers while the cited branch is the remote cutting or reaping image. It remains anchored because that image converges with focus dispersal and the opening's pulverized plant matter. Downstream prose should present it only as an etymological harvest resonance, not as a translation of the surface or a claim about the agents' identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus B002 branch permits a gathered whole to be cut apart and scattered into portions.

activation_trace.role: Dispersing a gathered whole into parts anchors the imagined result of reaping.
Crumbling husk and crop-leaf matter supplies the material field for a harvest-like separation.
Cutting and reaping supplies an etymological resonance in which the culpable are cut out from the whole.

changed_reading.before: The focus performs abstract judgment upon wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus resembles a harvest that cuts the culpable portion from a common field and disperses the residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the active plural most readily suggests external separators, whereas this branch locates F-R-Q inside the heart as fear. It remains valid through a direct focus branch and the ordered warning, threat, and calamity cues. Downstream prose should call it an affective undertone or effect, not replace the syntactic agency with a lexical claim that F-R-Q here simply means fear.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B009 branch permits separation to be experienced as inward scattering under intense fear.

activation_trace.role: The heart split or scattered by fear anchors an internal counterpart to external separation.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the immediate affective trigger.
A threat directed toward coming harm sustains the anticipatory pressure on the heart.
A severe descending event supplies the feared realization that converts anticipation into rupture.

changed_reading.before: Separation is wholly external and rearranges objects or populations.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the announced separation first happens affectively as warning and certain calamity scatter inner composure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it links the focus image of a laboring animal leaving its group with a later developmental enclosure and a T-L-Q labor branch whose surface occurrence commands departure. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch plus packet-supplied fluid, stable lodging, measure, and labor imagery. Downstream prose should label it a gestational analogy and not identify the focus agents as mothers, clouds, or birthing creatures.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus B008 branch includes a laboring female that separates from its group, making parturitional detachment a live but remote F-R-Q image.

activation_trace.role: A laboring female separating from the group anchors separation as gestational withdrawal and release.
Reproductive fluid placed in the womb supplies the material beginning of the gestational analogy.
Stability and settled residence supply the enclosing developmental interval before release.
A measure reaching its limit supplies the point at which enclosure can terminate.
The labor-pain branch supplies a remote release image that links appointed development to separation.

changed_reading.before: The focus is only destructive or judicial partition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, separation is parturitional release: a bounded development reaches its measure and detaches from protective enclosure.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence turns generic separation into a winnowing-like process in which force disperses, spreading exposes, and F-R-Q sorts.
Fixed timing and repeated F-S-L language revise the focus into scheduled adjudication rather than an indefinite natural action.
The gathering declaration shows that terminal separation can require prior assembly, reversing the baseline assumption that F-R-Q only scatters outward.
The two shade scenes make separation diagnostic: shared naming is overridden by the difference between apparent and effective protection.
Measured creation preserves a constructive branch in which separation individuates forms from common material.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made F-R-Q oscillate between destructive dispersion, constructive individuation, semantic clarification, routed divergence, and judicial partition. Repeated mirror scenes were especially activating because they showed separation often working on things first spread, gathered, contained, or made superficially alike.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening agents remain unidentified, so the sequential mechanism may describe one process, parallel agencies, or coordinated but distinct operations.
It is uncertain how strongly the later day of decision should retroactively govern the focus instead of merely echoing one available F-R-Q branch.
The fear, reaping, and gestational readings are branch-grounded resonances but remain too form-distant to carry unqualified prose.
